translation:
(Sambucus [陸英] is its envoy; it is averse to condensate water stone [凝水石] and croton [巴豆], and fears stiff silkworm [僵蠶] and Omphalia [雷丸].)

Original text of the Shennong Bencao Jing [本經]: Dendrobium [石斛], flavor sweet, neutral. It mainly treats damage to the center, removes bi [痹], sends qi downward, and supplements deficiency exhaustion and emaciation of the five viscera, and strengthens yin.
